## Highlights
### New
- Crest 0.8 lets coding agents use Crest as their browser on Mac, brings a rebuilt command palette and Settings, imports from many more browsers, and makes the sidebar quicker and more consistent.
### Improved
- Choose how much the sidebar’s tabs, folders and bars let the background show through, from Ultra Thin to Ultra Thick, in Look and Feel settings. Pinned tabs now sit closer under the address bar. - Tabs, folders, Split Views, pinned tabs and the address bar now share one shape and spacing that follows your corner setting. - Site Controls, Peek, notices and other floating panels use the same material as the sidebar. - With Capsule corners, single tabs are capsules, and Split Views and open folders round their corners to match.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
